title: A Diversity Diet for a Healthier Model: A Case Study of French ModernBERT
abstract: arXiv:2602.22014v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Diversity has been gaining interest in the NLP community in recent years. At the same time, state-of-the-art transformer models such as ModernBERT use very large pre-training datasets, which are driven by size rather than by diversity. This summons to investigate the impact of diversity on pre-training. We do so in this study, with the express intent of reducing pre-training dataset size, while retaining at least comparable performance. We compare diversity-driven sampling algorithms, and we use the best one to pre-train several ModernBERT models on French with a fixed compute budget. We fine-tune and evaluate them on a variety of French benchmarks. We compare them with models pre-trained on randomly sampled data of commensurate size, with the same compute budget. We find that both random and diversity-driven sampling may reduce the pre-training dataset by up to 94% and the pre-training time by up to 73% while maintaining performance

translated_title: 多样化“饮食”造就更健康的模型：法语 ModernBERT 案例研究
translated_abstract: 近年来，多样性在自然语言处理（NLP）社区中日益受到关注。与此同时，ModernBERT 等最先进的 Transformer 模型使用的预训练数据集规模非常庞大，其构建主要基于数据规模而非多样性。这促使我们研究多样性对预训练的影响。我们在本研究中开展了这一探索，明确目标是缩减预训练数据集的规模，同时保持至少相当的性能。我们比较了多种基于多样性的采样算法，并用其中最优的算法在固定计算预算下预训练了多个法语 ModernBERT 模型。我们在多种法语基准测试上对这些模型进行微调和评估，并将它们与在同等规模随机采样数据上、以相同计算预算预训练的模型进行比较。我们发现，无论是随机采样还是基于多样性的采样，都可以将预训练数据集缩减最多 94%，预训练时间缩短最多 73%，同时保持性能。
tldr: 该研究表明，采用基于多样性的数据采样策略，可以在保持性能的前提下将法语 ModernBERT 的预训练数据集缩减高达 94%、预训练时间缩短高达 73%。
en_tdlr: Diversity-driven sampling (and even random sampling) can reduce the pre-training dataset by up to 94% and training time by up to 73% for French ModernBERT while maintaining comparable performance.
